en: Captain, Coro! Welcome!

I heard that there would
be a dinner party, but I
had no idea it would be so
fancy! It all looks so
delicious!

I heard that there's a
place on Earth that has
festivals for girls each
spring, so I made the
same type of food as
what they sell at the
stalls.
You mean the Hina Doll\nFestival.

Impressive. You know
about Earth's culture,
despite the fact that you
grew up on an
underdeveloped planet.
Uh... Thank you.

I'm studying to be a
federation officer on Earth
now, and a friend of mine
in class told me all about
the Hina Doll Festival.

They dress up Hina dolls
in kimonos. It's a festival
dedicated to young girls,
praying that they grow up
big and strong.
It's also meant to drive\naway evil spirits at the\nchanging of the seasons.

I made all sorts of
preparations to drive
away evil spirits from this
ship.
Wow, that's fascinating\nstuff. Is that what your\noutfit is all about?

Oh, you noticed? It's
Japanese-style clothing. I
changed the color of my
hair, too.
I see that. It suits you.\nYou look great― like a\nreal-life Hina doll.
What, really!?
If I'm a Hina, that makes\nme a princess...and you a\nprince, Fidel...
We need to stand\nside-by-side, like they do\nat wedding ceremonies...
Oh, that's embarrassing.
But Fidel, traditional\nJapanese clothes would\nlook so good on you...
Miki, you're even more\nenthusiastic about this\nstuff than I am...
Oh, sorry!

I've recreated the food
exactly as my friend
described it. What do you
think? Go on, eat as much
as you want!
Hmm, not bad, not bad...
...Not bad...?
It's better than that. In\nfact, it's all incredibly\ndelicious.

Clam soup, Hishi mochi,
scattered sushi, and you
even grilled some rice
cakes.
That's the problem.\nWhere's the meat?
Hey, you there! Go out\nthere and bring us some\nfresh meat!
What? Me!? But I cannot\nleave the ship...
Don't just stand there! Get\nmoving!
Eeek!!! All right, I am going!

Event achievement
unlocked! Take a look by
tapping the Achievement
Button.
Hmm...
Um, Captain, can I ask you\nsomething?
Have I been...gaining\nweight lately?
No, you haven't.
You have nothing to worry\nabout.
It's not healthy to be too\nskinny.
Really? I feel like I'm\nmoving slower than usual.\nLike my body is heavier...
Something just doesn't\nfeel right.

Nothing to worry about?
Does that mean you
noticed the same thing,
Captain!?
So I must have gained\nweight... The food is so\ndelicious lately...
That's it! It's the food's\nfault! It's not my fault at\nall!
Ngh!
Guys always say stuff like\nthat...
Captain, what guys refer\nto as chubby, isn't chubby\nat all! I'm really really slim!
Guys can be so\nsuperficial!

You think it's healthier to
be on the heavier side? In
that case, maybe I'll keep
eating!
I'll even eat all the\nbananas Coro made for\nyou, Captain!!!
Enough with your yapping,\nyou incompetent schlub!
With a lax attitude like\nthat, it's only natural you'd\nend up flabby!
Fools! You should learn\nfrom me! Just look at my\nbody!
Rrrgh...
Miki, don't worry about it.
It's plain for everyone to\nsee who has the lax\nattitude and flabby body.
Thank you, Stephen. But\nit's not that...
It's not?
I've really been worried\nabout what I should do if I\nstarted to look like that...
I mean, for starters I'd\ndefinitely have to get all\nmy clothes modified...
And I'd sweat a lot, so I'd\nhave to do the laundry\nlike, all the time...

But then again being
heavier may be more
economical. After all, I'd
use less water in the tub...
I get the feeling you'd\nhave other more pressing\nconcerns...

Good point. It's like
Captain says. If you're
worried, why not take up
exercise?

Come to think of it, I could
use a good workout
myself. Want to go
together?
Really!?
Could you show me how\nyou swing a sword?

Of course. As a
swordsman, I'm always
happy to teach anyone
who shows a real interest.
Shall we begin?

Event achievement
unlocked! Take a look by
tapping the Achievement
Button.
Hooray! I hit my target\nweight! Stephen, thank\nyou so much!
My pleasure. It was time\nwell spent.

Hmm. What's this,
incompetent schlubs!?
Slacking off again, are
we?

Not at all, Deputy Director
Shimada. Stephen was
just teaching me how to
fight with a sword.
Like this!
Rrrgh...
Pathetic. You're terrible!

Wow. To call this level of
skill "pathetic"... Deputy
Director, maybe you would
deign to teach me a move
or two?
Rrrk... I...I'm too busy! I\ndon't have time for this\nnonsense!

Miki, I think you have a
real natural talent for the
sword. Have you had any
prior training?
Well... Yes, actually...

The man who raised me
after I lost my parents as
a young child ran a
sword-fighting school.
At first, I learned it along\nwith all the boys, but...
They always held back\nwhen they were fighting\nme, because I was a girl...
It made me so sad that I\nnever wanted to touch\nanother sword after that.

Shortly thereafter I
started to get into
symbology instead. I
enjoyed studying it more,
so...

The captain's right. Your
skill with the sword is
impressive. It would be a
shame to give it up
entirely.

While there may be
differences in physical
strength between men
and women...

...there are still plenty of
extremely talented female
sword masters in the
federation.

They all take advantage of
their physique, and often
unleash moves that put
men to shame.
What do you think of\nfinding a unique fighting\nstyle that suits you?
That is so true! Thank\nyou, Captain! Thank you,\nStephen!
I'll keep working on my\nswordsmanship, so I can\nbe useful to everyone!
Ah, Miki. Perfect timing!
Huh? What is it, Fidel?

You gave me some
chocolate the other day,
didn't you? I wanted to
return the favor.
Oh, don't tell me this is\nfrom the back-alley store\nin Myiddock...?

You bet it is―or rather as
close to it as you can get
out here. I remembered
how you said you liked
their bread...

So I talked to Coro, and
he said we could make it
with the replicator with
the information from the
database.
You made that bread for\nme? Thanks, Fidel!
The thing is...

When I made it, the
replicator malfunctioned
and output dozens of
copies of the same
bread...

I bet you could easily eat
this much though, right?
Go ahead, and eat it all!
Knock yourself out, Miki!
Huh? What's wrong? Don't\nhold back on our account.
Fiddly...
You idiot!!!
She took the bread and\nran off. I guess she must\nbe overwhelmed with joy!
Not to mention, it's been a\nwhile since she's called me\n"Fiddly."
...Fidel. You're terrible.
Huh?
